flags.fix:
adj | off-key; out of tune
ex: Anh ấy hát phô. = He sings off-key.

flags.why: This interjection is vulgar and needs an explicit warning tag, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C4%91%C3%B9).
Calling someone đù disparages their intelligence, so the meaning needs a derogatory warning.
The example defines the stroke instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Em viết sai nét gập trong chữ này. = You wrote the turning stroke in this character incorrectly.
